title: Outbox
description: kora-outbox bench: throughput, delivery delay, relay health, Postgres and consumer correctness.

panels.title: Messages per second
panels.description: Enqueued: outbox.send calls, counted before commit, so including sends whose transaction later rolled back. Committed: messages of committed writer transactions (bench.messages.sent). Delivered: handed to the handler (Kafka or noop) by the relay. Consumed: first-time messages the consumer accepted through the inbox.

panels.title: Delivery delay
panels.description: Time from the outbox insert to successful delivery (outbox.delivery.delay), 1 m window.

panels.title: Writer transaction latency
panels.description: One committed writer transaction of the load generator (bench.tx), 1 m window. Failed transactions are not recorded here; see Failed writer transactions.

panels.title: Committed writer transactions per second
panels.description: bench.tx count rate. In bulk mode each transaction carries messagesPerTx messages.

panels.title: Shard lag
panels.description: Age of the slowest shard's tick behind the newest tick (outbox.shard.lag), refreshed by maintenance every 30 s.

panels.title: Failed deliveries per second
panels.description: outbox.messages.failed by outcome: retry (kept for another attempt) or dead (moved to the dead table).

panels.title: Retry and dead tables
panels.description: Rows in outbox_retry and outbox_dead (outbox.retry.size, outbox.dead.size).

panels.title: Relay batch duration p99
panels.description: One relay batch: read, deliver, commit (outbox.batch.duration), 1 m window.

panels.title: Shard pauses per second
panels.description: outbox.shard.paused rate. The counter appears on the first pause; the series reads 0 while the app is up and has not paused.

panels.title: Xid partitions
panels.description: Premade: ranges ahead of the current xid (outbox.partitions.premade). Attached: partitions of the outbox table in Postgres, tail included (postgres-exporter).

panels.title: Requeues per second
panels.description: outbox.messages.requeued rate: records the handler set aside with Outcome.requeue, every requeue counted. No failure: no pause, no attempt spent.

panels.title: Parked records
panels.description: Rows in outbox_parked (outbox.parked.size): requeued records waiting for the next record of their key or their due time. outbox.shard.lag does not see them: a level that does not return to its baseline means records requeued over and over.

panels.title: Tail overflow
panels.description: outbox.partitions.overflow: 1 while inserts land in the tail partition because premade ranges ran out.

panels.title: Transactions per second
panels.description: pg_stat_database for the outbox database: every transaction, the relay's and the consumer's included.

panels.title: Connections
panels.description: Backends connected to the outbox database. max_connections shows in the legend and the tooltip only, so it does not flatten the backends line.

panels.title: Locks held
panels.description: pg_locks rows in the outbox database, advisory locks included (a bulk sendAll holds one per distinct key). The shared lock table holds about max_locks_per_transaction x max_connections = 256 x 300 entries.

panels.title: Outbox partition tree size
panels.description: pg_total_relation_size summed over the outbox table's partitions: heap, indexes and TOAST.

panels.title: Dead tuples in cursor and tick tables
panels.description: n_dead_tup of outbox_cursor and outbox_tick, the two hot-updated tables. A rising line means autovacuum is not keeping up.

panels.title: Duplicates in range
panels.description: Messages the inbox had already seen (bench.consumer.duplicates), over the selected time range. Expected above 0 after redeliveries (relay crash, Kafka outage, consumer restarts, rebalances): at-least-once delivery, deduplicated by the inbox. Warning colour, not an error.

panels.title: Order violations in range
panels.description: First-time messages whose per-user seq did not grow (bench.consumer.order_violations), over the selected time range. Must stay 0.

panels.title: Failed writer transactions in range
panels.description: Writer transactions that threw (bench.tx.failed), over the selected time range.

panels.title: Duplicates and order violations per second
panels.description: Rates of the two counters above.

panels.title: Kafka consumer lag
panels.description: records-lag-max of the worst partition, from the Kafka consumer client.

panels.title: Heap
panels.description: Used against committed heap, all G1 pools.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Share of all cores: the bench process, and the whole host it runs on.

panels.title: Hikari pool
panels.description: Connections of the bench pool: in use, threads waiting for one, and the pool size.

panels.title: GC pause time
panels.description: Share of wall time spent in GC pauses.
